strategy: Stabilize food for the next 5 minutes with immediate gathering, a small crop start, and one support/social check while keeping the base tidy.

Blaz.project: Gather nearby food quickly and return it to shared storage.
Blaz.say: Najprej hrana; takoj grem nabirat in prinesti nazaj.

Lara.project: Start a small crop patch near the settlement to improve steady food supply.
Lara.say: Postavil bom majhen gredicni začetek za bolj stabilno hrano.

Maja.project: Gather food directly from the nearest safe source and deposit it promptly.
Maja.say: Pobrala bom čim več hrane in jo takoj spravila v skupne zaloge.

Nejc.project: Scout a nearby safe food source and collect any easy food on the route back.
Nejc.say: Preverim najbližji varen vir hrane in vzamem, kar je hitro dosegljivo.

Zan.project: Check on a struggling member, help restore morale, and coordinate any spare food or tools back to base.
Zan.say: Najprej pomagam ekipi, potem pa uskladim vse, kar manjka.
